$comment: Source of truth for the first-time-player class/subclass picker. Generated output lives in class-selector/README.md and class-selector/decision-tree.md — see scripts/build-class-selector.mjs. Every leaf's flavor text (name, summary) is pulled live from classes/<class>/subclasses/<subclass>/subclass.json, never duplicated here.

q1.text: What's the fantasy that pulls you to the table? Go with your gut — there's no wrong answer.

options.label: I want to win fights through skill, steel, and nerve — no spellbook required.
My power comes from something greater than me: a god, the land, or the wild things living in it.
I want to master magic itself — its theory, its schools, its craft.
I win by knowing more than everyone else at the table: secrets, angles, misdirection.
My power comes from something vast, alien, or barely tamed — storms, dragons, the stars, dreams.
My power has a price. I made a deal, broke a vow, or simply refuse to stay dead.

q-r1.text: How do you want to win a fight?

options.label: I plant my feet and out-tough everyone on the field.
I make the people around me better at fighting.
I live and die by my own personal code of mastery.
I stay light on my feet and read the terrain (or the crowd).
I want a taste of magic without giving up my weapon.

q-r1a.text: When the damage starts piling up, what's your answer?

options.label: I shrug it off and keep swinging — simple, consistent, effective.
I fly into a rage that makes me nearly impossible to put down.
I turn my own armor into a weapon, spikes and all.
I just keep moving forward, and nothing stops my momentum.
I climb inside a suit of magical powered armor.

q-r1b.text: How do you make your allies better?

options.label: I call out precise maneuvers that trip, disarm, and control the fight.
I rally them with inspiring words and a banner worth dying for.
I plant myself between them and every enemy that gets close.
I channel a war god's fury directly into their weapon arms.
I bind myself to their protection through a sacred oath to the throne.

q-r1c.text: What does personal mastery look like for you?

options.label: An unbreakable code of resolve that keeps me fighting past death's door.
A duelist's charm — one-on-one, blade and wit.
Legendary feats that will be sung about for generations.
A single blade and a song, moving as one.
A weapon that's become an extension of my body and spirit.
My own fists and feet — no weapon needed at all.

q-r1d.text: What's your edge outside a straight fight?

options.label: I'm fast, light-fingered, and always one step ahead.
I adapt my tactics to whatever prey I'm hunting.
I hunt the things that hunt people — fiends, undead, aberrations.
My footwork looks like a drunk's stumble, but it's a killing art.
I turn into the beast myself.

q-r1e.text: How does magic show up in your fighting style?

options.label: It doesn't replace my weapon — it inspires the swings around me.
I dance through a fight, blade in one hand and a spell in the other.
I don't fight with steel at all — I end fights with a fireball.
I use magic like a tactician uses terrain — to control the battlefield.

q-r2.text: What's the source of your power, and who — or what — does it serve?

options.label: Keeping the people around me alive and whole.
A bond with the wild places and things of the world.
A spirit, ancestor, or creature that fights beside me.
A devotion so total it burns away everything else.

q-r2a.text: How do you keep your allies standing?

options.label: Overflowing divine healing, straight from the source.
I bind the party together so we protect and inspire each other.
A touch that heals or harms, and fists that flow like water.
Alchemical formulas and a healer's flask — no god required.
A pact with a being of pure light, healing woven into every spell.
Divine power that was simply born into my blood.

q-r2b.text: What's your bond with the wild?

options.label: A god of the wild speaks through me.
The land itself lends me its magic, wherever I stand.
Spirits of beasts answer my call to guard the weak.
An ancient oath sworn to the light that keeps the wild green.
An animal companion fights at my side, always.
I read the land and move through it like I was born there.
The spirit of a totem animal empowers my rage.
The ghosts of my ancestors guard my back.
My rage literally reshapes my body into a natural weapon.
A steel companion I built with my own two hands.

q-r2d.text: How far does your devotion go?

options.label: I fight like death itself has no hold on me, in a god's name.
An unbending, shining code of honor.
I'd rather turn an enemy from violence than strike them down.
I channel pure radiant fire against the dark.

q-r3.text: What kind of arcane practitioner are you?

options.label: Magic sharpens a weapon I'm already carrying.
My god and my spellbook agree on more than you'd think.
I want to specialize deep in one school of magic.
I build or create things that shouldn't be possible.

q-r3a.text: How does magic sharpen your weapon?

options.label: I weave spells between my sword strikes — a battle-mage through and through.
Every arrow I loose carries a spell with it.
I pick pockets with one hand and cast spells with the other.

q-r3b.text: What does your god know about magic?

options.label: Magic itself is my domain, arcane and divine intertwined.
I've dedicated myself to knowing everything that can be known.
I forge magic items the way a smith forges steel.

q-r3c.text: Which school of magic calls to you?

options.label: Wards, shields, and turning aside every hostile spell.
Summoning allies and objects out of thin air.
Glimpsing fate before it happens.
Reshaping matter itself.
I bind my magic into a living, sentient book.

q-r3d.text: What do you build with your magic?

options.label: Impossible objects, even life itself — sung or spoken into being.
My own body, plated and gearworked like clockwork.
Magical cannons and turrets that do my fighting for me.

q-r4.text: How do you get the upper hand?

options.label: Words. I can talk my way into or out of anything.
Knowing things nobody else knows yet.
The fight is already over before anyone sees me.
I run the whole game from the shadows.

q-r4a.text: How do you bend a room to your will?

options.label: I can talk anyone into anything, on stage or off.
Lies are just another tool of the trade — my god doesn't mind.
One word from me, and allies act instantly, no questions asked.
I don't ask — I make you agree with me.
I collect knowledge like treasure, with a cutting remark for every occasion.
I trade in fear, blackmail, and the things people don't want said aloud.
I hunt down dangerous magic and burn what shouldn't exist.
I notice the one detail everyone else missed.

q-r4c.text: How does the fight end before it starts?

options.label: I vanish into literal darkness and strike from it.
One perfect strike from hiding, and it's already over.
I hunt from the tree line, where the light doesn't reach.
I've sworn to end one target, whatever it costs me.

q-r4d.text: How do you control the battlefield without being seen?

options.label: I direct my allies from thirty feet back and let them take the credit.
Nothing you see around me is entirely real.

q-r5.text: What kind of vast, untamed power calls to you?

options.label: Raw elemental force — storm, fire, and fury.
The power of the mind itself.
Something whimsical, beautiful, and a little dangerous.
Something far bigger than this world.
Something ancient, huge, or wildly unpredictable.

q-r5a.text: Which element speaks loudest to you?

options.label: My aura shifts with the seasons — desert sun, arctic frost, storm-wracked sea.
I command thunder and lightning like a god's own storm.
I bend the four elements into martial arts techniques.
My magic and lightning are one — I can even ride the storm through the sky.
Fire itself answers me, and a fire spirit walks at my side.

q-r5b.text: How does your mind become a weapon?

options.label: I shape psychic energy into armor and weapons around my body.
I materialize a blade made of pure psychic force.
Alien knowledge lives in my head, and it grants me telepathy and psychic power.
I project spectral fists and a spirit-body of pure astral energy.

q-r5c.text: How does the Feywild touch your magic?

options.label: My performances captivate a room like fey enchantment.
I walk the border of the Feywild, equal parts charming and deadly.
I made a pact with a fey lord or lady of the First World.
I bring healing dreams and starlight into a weary camp.

q-r5d.text: Is your connection to the cosmic something that hunts, or something you study?

options.label: Something vast is out there, and dangerous — I stand watch against it.
The cosmos bends slightly around me — time, space, starlight, dusk.

q-r5d1.text: What's your relationship with the thing beyond?

options.label: I made a pact with an alien intelligence I'll never fully understand.
Something ancient sleeps in the deep ocean, and it speaks to me.
I hunt the aberrations and horrors that slip through from other planes.
A spectral echo of myself fights beside me, a half-step removed from time.

q-r5d2.text: What cosmic thread runs through your magic?

options.label: I tell stories that call spirits from beyond the grave to fight for me.
I read fate in the stars, and become a living constellation.
I bend time itself — slow it, rewind it, glimpse what's to come.
I bend gravity and space around my enemies.
I walk the line between day and night, guarding the space between.
I've walked every plane there is, and none of them scare me anymore.

q-r5e.text: Is your power something you were born with, or something wild and barely tamed?

options.label: Dragon's blood runs in me, and fire answers when I call.
My power is huge, chaotic, or barely leashed.

q-r5e1.text: How does dragon-blood show in you?

options.label: Scales, breath weapon, and a bloodline going back to actual dragons.
I channel the essence of a dragon spirit into my own fists and aura.
A drake hatched bonded to me, and we grow together.
Solar fire fills me and erupts from my fists.

q-r5e2.text: Just how much bigger and wilder does this get?

options.label: I grow into an actual giant, hurling boulders and knocking down walls.
Giant runes carved into my armor let me grow and command elemental forces.
A swarm of tiny fey spirits follows me everywhere I go.
My rage sets off unpredictable bursts of wild magic.
My spells are a gamble — glorious, chaotic surges, every time.

q-r6.text: What did your power cost you?

options.label: Nothing yet — but death and I have an understanding.
I refuse to let death be the end of my story.
A vow, broken, or a throne, terrified into submission.
My freedom, or my very blood.

q-r6a.text: What's your relationship with death itself?

options.label: My god governs death as a natural, sacred end.
I guard the border between life and death, and undeath offends me personally.
I command the dead to fight for me.
Fungal spores and decay flow through my magic — death feeds new life.
I've touched death so many times it no longer scares me — and I can spread that fear.
My patron has conquered death itself, and plague and undeath are its gifts to me.
My patron is literally undead, and its unnatural resilience has become mine.
A piece of the Shadowfell's death magic clings to my soul.

q-r6c.text: What did you have to break to get this power?

options.label: I broke my sacred oath, and dark power filled the void it left.
I terrify my enemies into submission, and I like it.
I sold a piece of myself to an infernal patron.
A sentient, cursed weapon chose me as its wielder.

q-r6d.text: What binds your power to something else?

options.label: Blood itself is the source and the price of my magic.
I'm bound in service to a genie, trapped in their vessel between wishes.
The Shadowfell seeped into my magic and never left.
